item.title: Village of Doyline holds first council meeting of 2026
item.description: By Shannon Wright The Village of Doyline held its regular monthly Town Council meeting, the first of the new year, on Monday, January 5. item.description: Peggy was found in Doyline frightened, starving, and painfully thin, little more than skin and bones.
